findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Paper towels were not available at the restroom handwashing sink. Paper towels were provided during inspection.
Each handwashing sink shall be provided with Individual, disposable towels or another approved drying option.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15 (A)(3) Light was visible along the left side of the back door on the north side of the building. PIC was advised as to the issue and replacement of weather stripping.
Outer openings of a food establishment shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15 Leak was observed on the left end of the large display cooler under door 10. Leak was also observed at the 2021 routine inspection. Provide proper repairs as the leaking water is causing damage to tiles under the cooler.
A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed
findings.citation_text:
5-402.13 While discussing practices for mopping, PIC noted used mop water is discarded outside in the dumpster area. This practice is to cease immediately. Moving forward all used mop water (waste water) must be disposed of in the mopsink and/or 3 part sink in the back room. 
All sewage and waste water must be routed to an approved sewage disposal system.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 REPEAT 1) Ceiling in mopsink room was sagging in one area with a portion of tiles removed and partially covered with wood paneling allowing for exposure of the area above the ceiling. Provide proper repairs with smooth, easily cleanable ceiling tiles.
REPEAT 2) Floor under large display cooler was observed with damaged tiles that were pulling up and in various states of disrepair due to the presence of a leak at the far left end of the display cooler (see #51). Floor needs to be cleaned, and tiles need to be replaced.
3) East wall was observed damaged along the top of base coving near the floor to the left of large display cooler adjacent to area where display cooler has a leak. A few spots in the wall next to the Pure juice cooler had holes where it appeared cloth towels were placed inside to seal holes. Provide proper repairs to the east wall.
4) Restroom ceiling tile was observed to be acoustic and without the proper ventilation cover. PIC noted the vent cover was falling off and was removed from the ceiling before it fell down. Replace acoustic tile and vent cover.
5) Hole was observed in the wall on the right side of shelving used for storage of energy drinks by the hallway to restroom and mopsink room. Repair the wall.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair. Repairs need to be made with durable materials that allow for smooth, easily cleanable surfaces.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-303.11 1) Light does not currently work in the mopsink room. 
2) Lights do not work properly in the back room on the north side of the building. Far left light in the ceiling barely turns on, and the light fixture more toward the middle of the room does not turn on at all. Extra ceiling light fixture is currently plugged in at ground level for use to provide light. 
Get the light fixtures repaired in these areas.
Light intensity shall be at least 10 foot candles (108 lux) at a distance of 30 inches (75 cm) above the floor, in walk-in refrigeration units and dry food storage areas and in other areas and rooms during periods of cleaning.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: Observed a small leak in the large display cooler. Ensure the leak is fixed. 
A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: The following surfaces need attention: 1) ceiling in the mop room is sagging - repair so it is smooth and easily cleanable (replace tiles if necessary); 2) repair the sagging ceiling tiles in the bathroom - make them smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable; 3) clean and repair floor under the long display cooler - when looking at the cooler it's the left side.
